portal.error.title: Could not open the portal

portal.signin.hint: Sign in with the name and password you were given.

portal.signin.badCredentials: That name and password do not match.

portal.invite.passwordRule: Choose a password with at least 10 characters.
portal.invite.passwordShort: Your password needs at least 10 characters.

portal.invite.redeemError: Cielo could not accept this invitation. Try again.
portal.invite.dead.used.title: This invitation has already been used
portal.invite.dead.used.hint: Ask the owner for a new invitation link.
portal.invite.dead.revoked.title: This invitation was called off
portal.invite.dead.revoked.hint: Ask the owner for a new invitation link.
portal.invite.dead.superseded.title: A newer invitation replaced this one
portal.invite.dead.superseded.hint: Ask the owner for the new invitation link.

portal.permission.heading: Cielo wants to {action} in {surface}.
portal.permission.noPreview: This one cannot be previewed. Cielo is telling you what it plans to do, but there is no before-and-after to show.
portal.permission.noChanges: There are no before-and-after details to show.
portal.permission.reversibleTrue: Yes. This can be undone if you change your mind.
portal.permission.reversibleFalse: No. This cannot be undone once it happens.
portal.permission.reversibleNull: We cannot tell whether this can be undone.
portal.permission.changed: This request changed while you were deciding. Here is the latest one.
portal.permission.notYours: This request is no longer yours to decide.
portal.permission.failed: Cielo could not record your answer. Try again.
portal.chat.lead: Ask Cielo to do something. It works on a real computer of its own, so it can look things up, write documents and spreadsheets, and put them in your files. When it finishes something you were not watching, it will tell you in Messages.
portal.chat.placeholder: Ask for a spreadsheet, a summary, a lookup...
portal.chat.inputLabel: What would you like Cielo to do?
portal.chat.working: Cielo is working on it. This can take a minute.
portal.chat.error: Cielo could not finish that. Try asking again.
portal.files.lead: Files you and Cielo share. Anything Cielo makes for you lands here.
portal.files.empty: Nothing here yet. Ask Cielo for something in Chat and it will show up.
portal.files.error: Could not read your files. Try again.
portal.files.downloadError: Could not save that file. Try again.
portal.widgets.lead: Jobs you ask for often, kept as a button. Give it a name and what to ask Cielo, then run it whenever you need it. Anything it makes lands in Files.
portal.widgets.empty: No tasks yet. Make one for something you ask Cielo for regularly — a weekly summary, a list you keep refreshing.
portal.widgets.promptPlaceholder: Make a spreadsheet of this week s sales by region and save it as sales.xlsx
portal.widgets.done: Done. Check Files for anything Cielo made.
portal.messages.lead: Pick someone to talk to. Messages come from the other people on this machine and from your own agent — nobody else can read them.
portal.messages.nobody: There is nobody else on this machine yet.
portal.messages.sendError: That message was not sent. Try again.
portal.projects.lead: Work your team has taken on. Whoever a task belongs to is the one who says how it is going.
portal.projects.error: Could not load projects just now.
portal.projects.empty: No projects yet. Start one above.
portal.home.promptLabel: What would you like to get done?
portal.home.prompt: What would you like to get done?
portal.home.partialError: Some parts of your workspace could not be refreshed.
portal.home.noHumanMessages: You are caught up with everyone.
portal.home.noProjects: Nothing has been assigned to you.
